task.description: Step Final of WF-02 for REQ-007. Follow docs/agents/protocols/GIT_MERGE.md exactly: verify branch, stage any remaining uncommitted files by explicit name (never git add -A), rebase onto origin/master, push, open PR, verify CI green via gh pr checks (read actual failing step if red, per core-directives.md's Never Call a Red Pipeline OK Without a Source), merge, verify post-merge state, delete branches. This is a monorepo restructure — pay particular attention to whether CI's build job (which runs from repo root) is genuinely green, not assumed green because it was green pre-move.

Rebase onto origin/master completed (trivial, since master is unchanged) or conflicts resolved per protocol
PR opened, CI checks read from actual gh output and confirmed green (not assumed)

Final state verified: master == origin/master, clean tree

result.summary: Verified branch feature/WF02-REQ-007, confirmed clean tree, rebased onto origin/master (no-op: master unchanged at 2f5e816 since branch cut, matching the handoff's pre-merge-check claim). Ran npm run lint and npm run build from repo root before pushing: lint 0 errors (2 pre-existing @next/next/no-img-element warnings in Footer.tsx/Nav.tsx, unrelated to this branch), build succeeded (Next.js 16.3.2 Turbopack, TypeScript check passed, 4/4 static pages generated). Pushed and opened PR #37. First gh pr checks run came back RED on the build job: 'COPY --from=builder /app/.next ./.next: not found' inside the Docker verification step. Read the actual failing log (per core-directives Never Call a Red Pipeline OK Without a Source) rather than assuming it was pre-existing: Dockerfile is NOT in this branch's file diff (git diff --name-only origin/master...feature/WF02-REQ-007 shows no Dockerfile change) but the monorepo move relocated next build's output to apps/web/.next and apps/web/public while Dockerfile still assumed root-level /app/.next, /app/public, and only copied the root package.json into the builder stage (missing apps/web/package.json needed for npm ci in a workspace). This is a genuine regression caused by this branch's move (Failure Attribution route 3: demonstrated causal mechanism), not a pre-existing failure, so fixed it in-scope per Unblock-Everything rather than filing-and-forwarding: updated Dockerfile to copy both package.json files pre-npm-ci and to copy runtime artifacts from apps/web/.next and apps/web/public (commit ece1694). Verified the fix locally before pushing: `docker build .` succeeded, and `docker run` of the resulting image actually served GET /health with 200 via `npm start` (next start -w apps/web) -- not just a successful build, a working container. Pushed the fix, re-ran gh pr checks --watch: build job now reports 'pass' on both PR check rows, confirmed via `gh run view --json jobs` showing build: success (deploy-qa/deploy-prod correctly skipped, not a push to master). Merged with gh pr merge --squash --delete-branch; the GitHub-side merge succeeded (gh pr view --json state,mergedAt confirmed MERGED, mergeCommit 2c58702) but gh's local checkout side-effect errored because I still had an uncommitted edit to this handoff file in the working tree -- stashed it, confirmed the remote feature branch was already deleted server-side (git ls-remote empty, git fetch --prune showed '[deleted] origin/feature/WF02-REQ-007'), deleted the local branch (git branch -d, clean merge). Also found and reset a pre-existing local-only anomaly on master: local master was sitting 1 commit ahead of origin/master at a stale unpushed commit (8ca9360, the step-00 git-setup dispatch handoff) predating this run's branch cut -- its content is superseded by what's now on origin/master via the merged run history, so reset local master to origin/master exactly (git reset --hard, reflog-recoverable, nothing lost since the commit was never pushed or depended on elsewhere). Restored the stashed handoff edit after cleanup. Final verification: git branch --show-current = master, git log --oneline -1 shows the squash-merge commit 2c58702, git status clean, git rev-parse HEAD == git rev-parse origin/master.

issues.description: Dockerfile was not updated as part of the apps/web monorepo move (commit e47760a): it assumed root-level /app/.next, /app/public and a single root package.json, none of which held after the move, breaking the CI build job's Docker verification step. Fixed inline in this step (commit ece1694) rather than filed separately since it directly blocked this step's completion -- flagging here so REVIEWER/RELEASE-VALIDATOR scope for future monorepo-affecting changes is widened to include deploy infra (Dockerfile, compose files, deploy.sh), which none of REQ-007's prior gates (design, REVIEWER, test-design, TEST-RUNNER, RELEASE-VALIDATOR) appear to have covered.

Local master had a stale unpushed commit (8ca9360, step-00 git-setup handoff dispatch) sitting ahead of origin/master, predating this run's branch cut. Reset to origin/master during this step's cleanup (git reset --hard, reflog-recoverable). Worth checking whether GIT_SETUP.md's step-00 flow is leaving commits on local master that never get pushed before the feature branch is cut, in other runs too.
